annotations.title: List the chat models with prices and curation verdicts

description: Lists the chat models this server serves: each gaents/<family> alias with its price per prompt and completion token, context length and the curation verdict from our own task tests (best for, superseded on, untested). Free; no input. Use it to pick a model and check its price before a chat call. Use recommend instead to get the measured best model for one named task. Use chat instead to run the model you picked. Free: listing models is never charged. Auth: none. Read-only; it has no error states of its own.
name: models_list

curation.description: our task-test verdict (from the curation ledger)

best_for.description: tasks it is on the measured frontier for

superseded_on.description: tasks where another model matches it for less

id.description: the model to send as chat model

reasoning.description: reasoning headroom added for this family
